parsed.rationale: All three members — `PlaybackBlendMode`, `MaterialBlendMode`, and `OverlayBlendMode` — are `type-alias-union` declarations in the same package (`Wallpaper`) with identical structure (`shared_field_count: 16`, `differing_slots: null`), meaning they are exact duplicates sharing all 16 union cases. Because they live in the same package and none carry test, codegen, mock, or sample-app flags, there is no intentional-duplication justification. The correct fix is to define a single canonical `BlendMode` type-alias-union in a new or existing shared file within `Shared/Wallpaper/Sources/Wallpaper/Core/` and replace all three aliases with `typealias PlaybackBlendMode = BlendMode`, `typealias MaterialBlendMode = BlendMode`, and `typealias OverlayBlendMode = BlendMode` (or remove the aliases entirely if call-sites can be migrated). This eliminates the risk of the three definitions drifting apart as new blend modes are added.
